text: PICTON Investments (Picton Mahoney Asset Management) is a Canadian investment firm, founded in 2004 and 100% employee-owned.

source.name: CI Global Asset Management: PICTON Investments (strategic partner profile)
source.quote: Founded in 2004 and 100% employee-owned, PICTON Investments is committed to helping advisors and investors rethink portfolio construction and achieve greater certainty in investment outcomes.
source.note: Undated live strategic-partner profile page on CI Global Asset Management; date is the day it was opened. Page names David Picton as founding partner, President and CEO.
